title: CoreWeave deal challenges Nvidia AI chip obsolescence fears
excerpt: CoreWeave recently rented Nvidia A100 GPUs into 2029, suggesting AI chips stay useful and hold their value far longer than critics feared.
content_html:
This 2020 Nvidia chip is still going strong. That matters for the AI boom.

By Alistair Barr

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Author of the Tech Memo newsletter

AI cloud company CoreWeave just offered fresh evidence in one of the biggest debates hanging over the AI boom: How long can AI chips stay useful and keep generating revenue?

The AI cloud company recently signed a contract to rent out Nvidia A100 GPUs well into 2029, CoreWeave Chief Financial Officer Nitin Agrawal told analysts late Tuesday. Nvidia introduced the A100 in 2020.

That means customers are committing to use these chips for running AI about nine years after their launch.

This matters because investors have been fiercely debating how quickly AI hardware loses its economic value. Critics and short sellers have argued that rapid advances from Nvidia could make older chips obsolete within two or three years. If that happened, companies spending billions of dollars on AI infrastructure might have to write down those investments much faster, hurting profits.

CoreWeave's latest deal suggests the opposite may be happening.

"We recently signed an A100 contract that extends into 2029 at an attractive price," Agrawal said. CoreWeave is also "largely sold out" of older generations of Nvidia chips, he added.

I first raised this depreciation risk before CoreWeave went public. Since then, evidence has increasingly suggested that useful GPU lives may be longer than feared. CoreWeave shares have surged since the initial public offering and jumped 20% on Wednesday.

Rental-market data backs up the company's comments. Silicon Data, which tracks GPU prices, says A100 rental rates have held up well after a strong rebound in 2026.

"We are still learning when it comes to the question of economic lifespan of GPUs. It certainly doesn't appear to be 2-3 years as some seem to casually assume," Silicon Data wrote in a post on X on Tuesday.

There are good reasons older GPUs can remain useful.

The newest chips are important for building the most advanced AI models. Once those models are created, companies have many other computing jobs that don't require the latest hardware. Older GPUs can be repurposed for these less demanding tasks and continue generating revenue.

Erwan Menard, a senior vice president at AI infrastructure company Crusoe, told me last year that GPUs can move from one type of work to another as they age. Lambda executive Matt Rowe has said their effective lives can stretch to seven or eight years.

GPUs inevitably break and have to be replaced. That cuts the useful life of a fleet of GPUs. However, observers worrying about depreciation often overlook warranty contracts, Rowe told me late last year. These warranties typically last five years, so if GPUs fail, they are replaced with new ones, extending the life of the overall GPU fleet.

The issue of GPUs' useful lives has become more important as Wall Street pours money into AI infrastructure. Nvidia this week announced partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR aimed at mobilizing more than $500 billion over time.

Those investments depend in part on AI hardware retaining its value for years.

An A100 still attracting customers into 2029 is a powerful test of that assumption, and, so far, an encouraging one.

content_html_zh:
这款 2020 款 Nvidia 芯片依然强劲。 这对于人工智能的繁荣至关重要。

作者：Alistair Barr 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 《技术备忘录》时事通讯的作者

人工智能云公司 CoreWeave 刚刚在人工智能热潮中悬而未决的最大争论之一中提供了新的证据：人工智能芯片能保持有用并持续产生收入多久？

CoreWeave 首席财务官 Nitin Agrawal 周二晚间对分析师表示，这家人工智能云公司最近签署了一份合同，将 Nvidia A100 GPU 出租至 2029 年。 Nvidia 于 2020 年推出了 A100。

这意味着客户承诺在这些芯片推出大约九年后使用它们来运行人工智能。

这很重要，因为投资者一直在激烈争论人工智能硬件失去经济价值的速度。 批评者和卖空者认为，英伟达的快速进步可能会使旧芯片在两三年内过时。 如果发生这种情况，在人工智能基础设施上花费数十亿美元的公司可能不得不更快地减记这些投资，从而损害利润。

CoreWeave 的最新交易表明，情况可能恰恰相反。

“我们最近以极具吸引力的价格签署了一份 A100 合同，该合同延长至 2029 年，”阿格拉瓦尔说。 他补充说，老一代 Nvidia 芯片的 CoreWeave 也“大部分已售罄”。

我在 CoreWeave 上市之前首先提出了这个贬值风险。 从那时起，越来越多的证据表明 GPU 的使用寿命可能比人们担心的要长。 自首次公开募股以来，CoreWeave 股价飙升，周三上涨 20%。

租赁市场数据支持了该公司的评论。 跟踪 GPU 价格的 Silicon Data 表示，A100 租金率在 2026 年强劲反弹后一直保持良好。

“对于 GPU 的经济寿命问题，我们仍在学习中。 当然不像有些人随意假设的那样需要 2-3 年，”Silicon Data 周二在 X 上的一篇文章中写道。

旧 GPU 仍然有用是有充分理由的。

最新的芯片对于构建最先进的人工智能模型非常重要。 一旦创建了这些模型，公司就有许多其他不需要最新硬件的计算工作。 较旧的 GPU 可以重新用于这些要求较低的任务，并继续产生收入。

人工智能基础设施公司 Crusoe 的高级副总裁 Erwan Menard 去年告诉我，随着 GPU 老化，它可以从一种工作类型转移到另一种工作类型。 Lambda 高管 Matt Rowe 表示，它们的有效寿命可以延长到七八年。

GPU 不可避免地会损坏并必须更换。 这会缩短 GPU 群的使用寿命。 然而，罗去年年底告诉我，担心折旧的观察家常常忽视保修合同。 这些保修期通常为五年，因此如果 GPU 出现故障，我们会更换新的 GPU，从而延长整个 GPU 组的使用寿命。

随着华尔街向人工智能基础设施投入大量资金，GPU 的使用寿命问题变得更加重要。 Nvidia 本周宣布与 Apollo、BlackRock、Blackstone、Brookfield、Goldman Sachs 和 KKR 建立合作伙伴关系，旨在随着时间的推移筹集超过 5000 亿美元的资金。

这些投资部分取决于人工智能硬件能否在多年内保持其价值。

A100 到 2029 年仍能吸引客户，这是对这一假设的有力检验，而且到目前为止，这是一个令人鼓舞的假设。
